description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maholawa, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420582 (24/0006)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot No. 1:48 of Block 03) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and registration details. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land registration and property ownership matters.
